children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Enable credentialed content registries without leaking keys and understand why a provider appears or remains hidden.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A configured key does not make a registry relevant to every game, loader, or module capability.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Some registries are always available; others remain hidden until credentials and compatibility requirements are met.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: CurseForge, Steam Workshop, and Nexus require configured credentials.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Modrinth, Thunderstore, Hangar, GitHub, and others may be always-on.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Game, loader, version, and module capabilities still filter relevance.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Set, replace, or remove a key

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use the credential control so the value is stored in a Secret, never in metadata, URLs, logs, or screenshots.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Set a key for an unconfigured provider; Replace an existing one.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Removing a key hides or disables the provider.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Check required update/install workflows before removal.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Run a compatible harmless search, diagnose without exposing the key, then rotate and revoke on a schedule.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Set/Replace stores Secret; Remove hides or disables provider

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test search → rotate → retest metadata/install → revoke old key

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
